name: conv3d
description: An interactive CLI tool for converting 3D models to GLB format and outputting React components to use with r3f. Supports FBX, OBJ, and glTF input formats.

scripts.pub: npm version patch && npm run build && npm publish --access public
scripts.release:patch: npm version patch -m "chore: release v%s" && npm run _release:finish
scripts.release:minor: npm version minor -m "chore: release v%s" && npm run _release:finish
scripts.release:major: npm version major -m "chore: release v%s" && npm run _release:finish
scripts._release:finish: npm run build && npm test && npm publish --access public && git push --follow-tags && npm install -g .

author: Rico Trebeljahr
